name: CCI(20) < -150 bounce long, exit CCI > 150 or 8% stop
author: Pine community script (Italian-style CCI system)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Long when prior-bar CCI(20) < -150 and CCI rises above its previous value (cci > cci[1]) and signal bar closes at least 0.25% above its open.
exit: Close long when CCI > 150 (target) or close falls 8% below entry (stop).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: A window() date filter exists in the script; thresholds all input-driven.
